title: Crossword clues for vocabulary learning
subject: ELA / Vocabulary
details: A free, account-free 20-minute classroom routine that teaches students to infer word meaning from clue wording, answer length, grammar, context, and crossing letters. The guide includes learning objectives, differentiation, discussion prompts, an exit ticket, a hint-first solver, and a downloadable reviewed dataset. Full disclosure: I maintain Crossword Clue Tutor.
